senses.gloss:
लालप्यमान लालप्यमान. See p. 861,
col. 2.

लल् लल् (= rt. लड्), cl. 1. P. A. ललति,
ललते, &c., to play, sport, frolic, dally;
to play (with the tongue); cl. 10. P. ललयति, &c.,
to loll the tongue, &c. (see rt. लड्): Caus. P. लाल-
यति, &c. (according to some also ललयति), to cause
to sport or dally; to caress, fondle, coax, cherish,
nurse, love; A. लालयते, &c., to desire, &c.

लल, अस्, आ, अम्, sporting, frolicking, playful;
lolling, wagging; wishing, desirous.
—लल-जिह्व =
ललज्-जिह्व below.

लाल, अस्, m., N. of an astronomer; (आ), f. saliva,
spittle, slaver.
—लाल-चन्द्र, अस्, m. a proper N.
—लाल-वत्, आन्, अती, अत् (लाल for लाला), causing
saliva to flow.
—लाल-सिंह, अस्, m., N. of an astro-
nomer.
—लाला-भक्ष, अस्, m. ‘having saliva for
food, ‘N. of the hell appropriated to those who eat
their meals without first offering food to the gods,
to the Manes, or to guests.
—लाला-मेह, अस्, m.
[]
passing mucous urine.
—लाला-विष, अस्, आ, अम्,
whose saliva is poison (said of venomous insects).
—लाला-स्रव, अस्, m. ‘distilling saliva,’ a spider.
—लाला-स्राव, अस्, m. a flow of saliva or spittle;
‘emitting saliva,’ a spider.
—लाला-स्राविन्, ई, इणी, इ,
causing a flow of saliva.

लाल लाल, लालक, लालित, &c. See p. 863,
cols. 1, 2.

लल्ल लल्ल, अस्, m., N. of an astronomer;
of certain other persons; (आ), f., N. of a courtezan
(in Rāja-tarangiṇī VIII. 1834, &c.).
—लल्ल-वा-
राह-सुत, अस्, m. the son of Lalla and Vārāha, N.
of the author of the Nakṣatra-samuccaya.

ललत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, playing, sporting, dallying;
playing with the tongue, &c.
—ललज्-जिह्व, अस्, आ,
अम्, playing with the tongue, lolling the tongue,
moving the tongue hither and thither; fierce, savage;
(अस्), m. a camel; a dog.
—ललद्-अम्बु, उस्, m. a
particular plant (= लिम्पाक).

ललन, अस्, आ, अम्, playing, coruscating (said of
light, colour, &c.); sporting; (अस्), m., N. of various
plants, = साल, प्रियाल; (आ), f. a wanton woman;
a woman (in general), a wife; the tongue; N. of
several metres, four times ¯˘˘¯¯, ¯˘˘¯˘˘¯;
four times ¯˘˘¯¯, ˘˘˘˘˘˘¯; a particular
kind of Gāthā; N. of a mythical being; (अम्), n.
play, sport, pleasure, dalliance; the playing or mov-
ing to and fro of the tongue; lolling the tongue.
—ललना-प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, dear to women, liked
by females; (अस्), m. Nauclea Cadamba; (अम्), n.
= ह्री-वेर, a kind of drug.
—ललना-वरूथिन्, ई,
इनी, इ, surrounded by a troop of women.

लालन, अस्, ई, अम्, caressing, fondling, coaxing;
(अस्), m. a particular venomous animal, a sort of
mouse; (अम्), n. the act of caressing, fondling,
coaxing, dandling; spoiling, indulging, over-indulg-
ing.
ललनिका, f. a little woman, a miserable woman.

ललन्तिका, f. (fr. ललन्ती, fem. of ललत्), a long
pendulous necklace; a lizard, chameleon.
ललमान, अस्, आ, अम्, sporting, playing, dallying.
ललाक, अस्, m. the penis.

लालक, अस्, इका, अम् (fr. the Caus. of rt. लल्),
caressing, fondling, coaxing, seducing; (इका), f. a
jesting or evasive reply, equivoque.

ललित, अस्, आ, अम्, sported, played, playing, sport-
ing, dallying, wanton, frolicsome, amorous, volup-
tuous; lovely, handsome, beautiful, graceful, elegant,
naive, simple, artless, gay, cheerful; soft, gentle;
pleasing, charming, pleasant, agreeable, wished for,
desired, loved; trembling, tremulous, shaken; = च-
लित; (अम्), ind. sweetly, agreeably, gracefully;
(अस्), m. epithet of a particular position of the hands
in dancing; N. of a particular musical scale or Rāga,
(according to some ललिता, f.); (आ), f. a wanton
woman, a woman in general; musk; N. of a god-
dess; of a form of Durgā or Pārvatī; of a Gopī
(identified with Durgā and Rādhikā); of a river;
of various metres, 30 + 32 instants; four times

four times ˘˘˘˘˘˘¯¯¯¯˘¯; N. of a town.
—ललित-चैत्य, अस्, m., N. of a particular Caitya.
—ललित-ताल, अस्, m., N. of a particular time (in
music).
—ललित-पद, अस्, आ, अम्, consisting of
amorous words; elegantly composed; a kind of
metre, four times ˘˘˘˘¯˘˘¯˘˘¯¯.
—ललित-
पद-बन्धन, अम्, n. an amorous composition
in verse, a metrical composition treating of love.
—ललित-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town.
—ललित-
पुराण, अम्, n. = ललित-विस्तर-पुराण.
—ल-
लित-प्रहार, अस्, m. a soft or gentle blow.
—ल-
लित-माधव, अम्, n., N. of a drama by Rūpa.
—ललित-ललित, अस्, आ, अम्, excessively beautiful,
very handsome.
—ललित-लोचन, अस्, आ, अम्, beauti-
ful-eyed; (आ), f., N. of the daughter of a Vidyā-dhara
Vāma-datta.
—ललित-वनिता, f. a lovely woman.
—ललित-विस्तर, अस्, m. or ललित-विस्तर-पुरा-
ण, अम्, n., N. of a Sūtra work giving a detailed
record of the simple and natural acts in the life of
Buddha or Śākya-muni.
—ललित-व्यूह, अस्, m.
epithet of a particular kind of Samādhi or meditation
(with Buddhists); N. of a Deva-putra; of a Bodhi-
sattva.
—ललिता-तृतीया, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra
work.
—ललिता-तृतीय, f. epithet of a particular
third day.
—ललितादित्य (˚त-आद्˚), अस्, m., N. of
a king of Kaśmīra.
—ललितादित्य-पुर, अम्, n.,
N. of a town founded by Lalitāditya.
—ललिता-पञ्-
चमी, f. the fifth day of the moon's increase in
the month Āśvina on which the worship of the
goddess Lalitā or Pārvatī is celebrated.
—ललितापीड
(˚त-आप्˚), अस्, m., N. of a king of Kaśmīra.
—ल-
लिताभिनय (˚त-अभ्˚), अस्, m. erotic performance,
representation of love scenes.
—ललिता-माधव =
ललित-माधव.
—ललिताचन-चन्द्रिका (˚ता-
अर्˚), f., N. of a work on the worship of Lalitā.
—ललितार्थ (˚त-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having an
amorous meaning.
—ललितार्थ-बन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्,
composed in words of love or in words having an
amorous meaning.
—ललिता-व्रत, अम्, n., N. of a
particular religious observance.
—ललिता-षष्ठी,
f. epithet of a particular sixth day.
—ललिता-सप्-
तमी, f. epithet of the seventh day in the light half
of the month Bhādra.
ललित ललित, &c. See col. 1.

लालित, अस्, आ, अम्, caressed, tenderly cherished,
fondled, nursed, coaxed, indulged, seduced; loved,
desired; (अम्), n. pleasure, joy, love.
ललितक or ललितिक, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.

लालितक, अस्, m. a fondling, darling, little favourite,
pet.
ललिथ, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
ललीतिका, f., N. of a place of pilgrimage.

लालनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be caressed or fondled or
coaxed.
लालयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, caressing, coaxing; stroking.
लालयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = लालनीय.

लालाय, Nom. A. लालायते, &c., to emit saliva,
slaver.

लालायित, अस्, आ, अम्, emitting or discharging
saliva.
लालिक, अस्, m. a buffalo; [cf. लाविक.]
लालिक लालिक. See p. 863, col. 2.

लालित्य, अम्, n. (fr. ललित), loveliness, grace,
beauty, pleasingness, pleasantness, sweetness, loveli-
ness, charm, grace, beauty; gaiety; amorous or lan-
guid gestures.

लालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, caressing, fondling, coaxing; (ई),
m. a seducer; (इनी), f. a wanton.
लालील, अस्, m., Ved., N. of Agni.
लाल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = लालनीय.

ललल्ल ललल्ल, an onomatopoetic word
representing a lisping sound.

ललाट ललाट, अम्, n. (a later form of र-
राट, q. v.), the forehead, brow, (ललाटे, ‘on the
forehead, in front;’ the destiny of every individual
is conceived by the Hindūs to be written on the
forehead.)
—ललाट-तट, अम्, n. the slope of the
forehead, the forehead.
—ललाटन्-तप, अस्, आ, अम्,
burning the forehead (as the sun).
—ललाट-पट्ट,
अम्, n. or ललाट-पट्टिका, f. ‘the plate’ or flat surface
of the forehead, the forehead; a tiara, fillet.
—ल-
लाट-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town.
—ललाट-फ-
लक, अम्, n. the flat surface of the forehead.
—ल-
लाट-रेखा, f. a line on the forehead supposed to
indicate long life; a wrinkled or corrugated brow;
a coloured sectarial mark on the forehead.
—लला-
टाक्ष (˚ट-अक्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, having an eye in the
forehead; (अस्), m. an epithet of Śiva.

लालाट लालाट, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. ललाट), being
in or on the forehead, relating to it, &c.

ललाटक, अम्, n. a beautiful forehead; the fore-
head, brow; (इका), f. an ornament worn on the fore-
head; a mark made with sandal on the forehead.

ललाटिकाय, Nom. A. ललाटिकायते, &c., to re-
present or be like a mark on the forehead.

ललाटिकायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, representing a mark
on the forehead.

ललाटूल, अस्, आ, अम्, having a high or handsome
forehead.

ललाट्य, अस्, &c. = रराट्य, of or belonging to
the forehead.

ललाम ललाम, अम्, n. (probably connected
with rt. लल्; cf. ललाट), a mark or spot on the
forehead, mark or spot in general; an ornament
for the forehead, ornament, decoration, embellish-
ment in general, (in this sense also अस्, m.); a
coloured mark on the forehead of a horse or bull,
&c.; a sign, symbol, token, mark of caste, &c.; a
banner, flag, ensign; a line, row; any one who is
the ornament of his class, any eminent or principal
person, (in this sense even अम्, n.); anything the
best of its kind, any grand or beautiful object; emi-
nence, beauty, dignity; a tail; a mane; a horn (?) ;
(अस्, ई, अम्), having a mark or spot on the forehead,
marked with a blaze (said of cattle); beautiful, agree-
[]
able, charming; (अस्), m. a horse; (ई), f., N. of a
female demon (Ved.); a kind of ornament for the
ears.
—ललाम-गु, उस्, m., Ved. a facetious term for
the penis.
—ललाम-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a mark
or spot; having an ornament.

ललामक, अम्, n. a chaplet or wreath of flowers
worn on the forehead.
—ललामक-रूपक, अम्,
n. (in rhetoric) a flowery metaphor.

ललामन्, अ, n. = ललाम, an ornament, decora-
tion; a mark, sectarial mark; sign, symbol, token;
a banner, flag; any one who is the ornament of his
class; any chief or principal person or thing; a tail;
a horn (?) ; a species of stanza having ten syllables
in the first two Pādas, eleven in the third, and thir-
teen in the fourth; a horse, (in this sense probably
आ, m.); = रम्य; = सुख.
लल्यान लल्यान, N. of a place.
लल्लिय लल्लिय, अस्, m. a proper N.

लल्लुजीलाल लल्लुजीलाल, अस्, m., N. of an
author.
लालष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, eagerly longing for.

लालस लालस, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Intens.
of rt. 1. लस्, but probably connected also with rt.
लष्), eagerly longing for, ardently desirous of, eager
after; finding pleasure in, devoted to, totally given
up to [cf. शोक-ल्˚]; (अस्, आ), m. f. longing or ardent
[]
desire, eagerness; regret, sorrow; asking, soliciting;
the longing of a pregnant woman; dalliance?; (आ),
f. a particular metre, four times ˘˘˘˘˘˘¯˘¯¯,
˘¯¯˘¯¯˘¯.
लालसीक, अम्, n. sauce, gravy.
लालाटि, इस्, m. a patronymic.
लालाटी, f. = ललाट, the forehead.

लालाटिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the forehead,
being on the forehead; relating to fate, arising from
destiny; looking attentively at the forehead (of a
master), attentive; useless, low, vile; (अस्), m. an atten-
tive servant, one who watches a master's countenance
and learns by it what is necessary to be done; one
who is unfit for work (as depending too much on
the look of his superior), a careless person or idler
(perhaps as always gazing at the countenances of
others); a mode of embracing.

लालामिक लालामिक, अस्, ई, अम्, = ललामं
गृह्णाति, Pāṇ. IV. 4, 40.
लालुका लालुका, f. a sort of necklace.
